from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct,zlib
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;inventory=p.parent/'native-shield-binding-stock-audit-01/all-shields-report.json';prior=json.loads(inventory.read_text())
master=Path('/home/maciek/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Oblivion/Data/Oblivion.esm');data=master.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==prior['master_sha256']
records=[]
def walk(start,end):
 while start<end:
  tag=data[start:start+4];size=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,start+4)[0]
  if tag==b'GRUP':walk(start+20,start+size);start+=size;continue
  flags,fid=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,start+8)
  if tag==b'ARMO' and not flags&0x20:
   body=data[start+20:start+20+size]
   if flags&0x40000:
    expected=struct.unpack_from('<I',body)[0];body=zlib.decompress(body[4:]);assert len(body)==expected
   at=0;fields={};extended=None
   while at<len(body):
    sub=body[at:at+4];n=struct.unpack_from('<H',body,at+4)[0];at+=6
    if sub==b'XXXX':extended=struct.unpack_from('<I',body,at)[0];at+=n;continue
    if extended is not None:n=extended;extended=None
    assert at+n<=len(body);fields[sub]=body[at:at+n];at+=n
   if struct.unpack_from('<H',fields.get(b'BMDT',b'\0\0'))[0]&0x2000:
    models={s.decode():fields[s].rstrip(b'\0').decode().replace('\\','/').lower() for s in (b'MODL',b'MOD2',b'MOD3',b'MOD4') if fields.get(s,b'').rstrip(b'\0')}
    records.append(dict(form=hex(fid),editor_id=fields.get(b'EDID',b'').rstrip(b'\0').decode(),models=models))
  start+=20+size
 assert start==end
walk(0,len(data));assert len(records)==prior['armor_records']==206
old={r['form']:r for r in prior['records']}
rows=[]
for r in records:
 m=r['models'];assert {k:v for k,v in m.items() if k!='MOD4'}==old[r['form']]['models']
 ground=m.get('MOD2','');male=m.get('MODL','');female=m.get('MOD3') or male;female_ground=m.get('MOD4') or ground
 if male!=ground or female!=ground or female_ground!=ground:rows.append(dict(form=r['form'],editor_id=r['editor_id'],ground=ground,male=male,female=female,female_ground=female_ground))
report=dict(passed=True,master_sha256=prior['master_sha256'],source_inventory_sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),records=len(records),female_world_MOD4_present=sum('MOD4' in r['models'] for r in records),different_ground_carried=rows,scope='Independent raw installed-master role inventory, including MOD4 omitted by the older three-field audit: carried MODL/MOD3 and world MOD2/MOD4. Empty female world role falls back to male world role, checked independently by world-model-probe.py. This content enumeration is not runtime acceptance.')
(p/'model-role-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print('Shield records',report['records'],'ground/carried differences',len(rows),'female MOD4 fields',report['female_world_MOD4_present'])

import hashlib,itertools,json,struct
from unicorn import Uc,UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_32,UC_HOOK_CODE
from unicorn.x86_const import *

u=Uc(UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_32);u.mem_map(0,0x1000);u.mem_map(0x400000,0x900000);u.mem_map(0x2000000,0x10000)
for _,va,raw,size in m['sections']:u.mem_write(va,data[raw:raw+size])
def w(a,v):u.mem_write(a,struct.pack('<I',v))
def ri(a):return struct.unpack('<I',u.mem_read(a,4))[0]
def ret(value):
 sp=u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_ESP);u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_EAX,value);u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_EIP,ri(sp));u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_ESP,sp+4)
armor,reference,npc,stack,end=0x2001000,0x2002000,0x2003000,0x200e000,0x2000000
w(armor,0xa441bc);w(armor+0x64,0xa3b7a8)
seen=[]
def hook(uc,ip,size,_):
 if ip==0x4db6b0:
  assert uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_ECX)==reference;seen.append('resolved-base');ret(npc if kind!='null-base' else 0)
 elif ip==0x519d20:
  assert uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_ECX)==npc;seen.append('npc-sex');ret(kind=='female')
u.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE,hook)
rows=[]
for kind,empty_male,empty_female,long_length in itertools.product(('no-reference','null-base','armor-base','male','female'),(False,True),(False,True),(False,True)):
 paths={0x6c:'carried-male.nif',0x84:'carried-female.nif',0x9c:'' if empty_male else 'world-male.nif',0xb4:'' if empty_female else 'world-female.nif'}
 for i,(offset,path) in enumerate(paths.items()):
  address=0x2004000+i*0x100;u.mem_write(address,path.encode()+b'\0');w(armor+offset,0xa3c24c);w(armor+offset+4,address);u.mem_write(armor+offset+8,struct.pack('<H',0xffff if long_length else len(path)))
 u.mem_write(npc+4,bytes([0x14 if kind=='armor-base' else 0x23]));w(stack,end);w(stack+4,armor);w(stack+8,0 if kind=='no-reference' else reference)
 seen=[];u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_ESP,stack);u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_EBP,0)
 try:u.emu_start(0x4693e0,end,count=10000)
 except Exception:print('fault',kind,hex(u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_EIP)));raise
 assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_EIP)==end and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_ESP)==stack+4
 result=u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_EAX);actual=bytes(u.mem_read(result,100)).split(b'\0')[0].decode() if result else None
 expected=paths[0xb4] if kind=='female' and not empty_female else paths[0x9c]
 assert actual==expected,(kind,empty_male,empty_female,long_length,actual,expected)
 rows.append(dict(kind=kind,empty_male=empty_male,empty_female=empty_female,sentinel_length=long_length,selected=actual,boundaries=seen))
report=dict(passed=True,cases=len(rows),executable_sha256=m['sha256'],actual_paths=['4693E0 model selection','actual MSVC RTTI dynamic cast 9832E6 from ARMO primary vtable A441BC, biped component offset64','4692E0 gender fallback and TESModel virtual getter'],instruction_mapping=dict(MODL='ARMO+6C, carried male',MOD2='ARMO+9C, world male',MOD3='ARMO+84, carried female',MOD4='ARMO+B4, world female',proof='Original ARMO loader4B4D90 compares subrecord tags and calls TESModel setters at these exact offsets.'),boundaries=['4DB6B0 resolved owner is supplied (owner inheritance is audited separately in M15-NATIVE-RULE-PROVENANCE.md): null, nonNPC, maleNPC, femaleNPC. This harness does not prove its internal resolution.','519D20 NPC sex is supplied for NPC base inputs.','Model loading, geometry/physics and runtime acceptance are outside the executed selector.'],observation='No-reference, null owner and nonNPC owner choose male MOD2. Female NPC owner chooses MOD4 unless its string is empty, then MOD2. Carried MODL/MOD3 are distinct fixture paths and never selected here.',rows=rows)
(out/'world-model-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print('Original world model selector:',len(rows),'passed')
